desc: Select primary approach: sliding-window median costs plus exact-k non-overlapping window DP.

Implement the complete solution in the starter code: coordinate-compress nums, maintain two Fenwick trees (counts and sums) for the sliding length-x window to compute each window's minimum uniform cost via the lower median, then run the two-row DP dp[t][i] = min(dp[t][i-1], dp[t-1][i-x] + cost[i-x]) to return the minimum for exactly k non-overlapping windows.

Run the current solution on the two provided examples, the 200 seeded random brute-force comparisons, and targeted edge cases (x = n, k*x = n, all equal values, negative values, duplicates, even x); report pass/fail and any mismatching case.

Benchmark the current Solution on n=100000 random arrays for x=2 with k=15, x=50000 with k=2, and x=100000 with k=1; if runtimes are acceptable, remove brute_force and the __main__ harness and return only the clean Solution class.
